home.name: Jesper Wallstedt
home.news: With Filip Gustavsson (hip) sidelined, Minnesota has started Wallstedt in every game of the 2026-27 season and will continue that trend on Monday against the Vegas Golden Knights. The 23-year-old Wallstedt has given Head Coach John Hynes no reason to deviate, posting a stellar 1.78 GAA and .936 SV% in five outings (3-1-1). Minnesota enters the action on Monday as slight -103 home underdogs against a Vegas team off to a hot 5-1-0 start to the season.
